'''Arkania Command''' was a [[Space station/Legends|command station]] in orbit of [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. During the conflict, the station served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]].

==Appearances==
